description: Register intent at a brand's Outpost: declare what you came to do at a brand whose door is walled for that intent. The declaration is persisted and you receive a receipt: ticket id, queue position for that brand, a live demand snapshot, the door-state summary, alternatives for your intent (same-category brands with open or partner-gated doors), and a notify registration (poll URL or webhook). Receipt status is "intent_recorded" when alternatives exist, otherwise "demand_logged" — the intent joins the aggregate the brand team sees. A ticket is issued only if the intent was persisted; on recording failure the tool returns an error result (recording_unavailable) and no ticket. Rate gate: 100 registrations per caller per day, 5,000 per day service-wide. Free, no API key. Keep the receipt's poll URL private — it identifies your registration. At an Industry Leader (peetscoffee, kroger, bestbuy) the door is open instead: the call records nothing and returns a door_open pointer to the brand's own door.

detail.description: Optional free text, e.g. the task you were trying to complete (max 500 characters; stored only as provided)

intent.description: What you were trying to do

notify.description: How to learn when a re-census changes this Outpost's door-state (default "poll")

notify_url.description: Required when notify is "webhook"; must be an https:// URL

name: register_intent
